purpose: Canonical source hierarchy for European first-visit editorial ratings, stories, GPS, operations and future refreshes.

rating_policy.five_star: First-time essential. Removing it materially weakens the visitor's understanding or signature experience of that city/base.
rating_policy.four_star: Strong recommendation. Add when time, weather, interest and driving energy support it.
rating_policy.not_public_rating: Editorial 4/5 stars are NOT Google/Tripadvisor star averages.
rating_policy.public_review_role: Public-review scores/counts may be stored as separate evidence through licensed/approved APIs. They never automatically determine editorial rating and review text must not be bulk copied or scraped.
rating_policy.low_priority_policy: 3-star and lower content stays hidden from default first-time guide unless a theme explicitly needs it.

source_tiers.name: Structured geographic evidence
examples: OpenStreetMap where official coordinates are unavailable
source_tiers.rule: Never present a vague city geocode as an exact attraction coordinate.

source_tiers.name: Independent travel editorial
source_tiers.rule: Summarize independently; do not copy protected guide text.

source_tiers.name: Crowd evidence
use_for: recurring practical complaint patterns when legally available
source_tiers.rule: Keep numeric crowd evidence separate from editorial stars; do not scrape or republish bulk reviews.

North Macedonia: official destination/cultural heritage sources to be preferred on refresh

refresh_policy.gps: Reverify if an entrance/terminal moved, not on every content refresh.
refresh_policy.operations: Refresh close to travel date and at least annually for public guide data that states season/open status.
refresh_policy.mountain_and_park: Check 7–14 days before travel and same day for lifts, mountain roads, weather, snow/ice and park-route closures.
refresh_policy.ferry: Current ticket and terminal instructions override static guide data.
refresh_policy.public_review_evidence: If added, timestamp retrieval and never overwrite editorial rating automatically.
